highlights: Give an agent more than one conversation: click + in the chat header to start a new thread. Your tasks are now threads.
Attach MP4 videos in chat, and see image files that an agent names as previews under its answer.
Connect Obsidian, Trello, Render, Neon, Prisma, Netlify, Railway, Atlassian, Todoist and Hugging Face from the new Marketplace.
OpenBot is now available in Dutch.
Workspace only Pi, Cursor and DeepSeek agents on macOS work again, and a provider CLI update no longer stops OpenBot at start.
